'''Charles Auguste Briot''' (19 July 1817  St Hippolyte, Doubs, Franche-Comté, France – 20 September 1882  Bourg-d'Ault, France) was a French mathematician who worked on [[elliptic function]]s. The [[Académie des Sciences]] awarded him the [[Poncelet Prize]] in 1882.
